notes: Standard 2-letter English subtitle. Most common format per Plex/Emby/Jellyfin conventions.
3-letter English subtitle. Also supported by Plex (ISO 639-2/B).
BCP 47 tag with US region. American English variant.
British English variant. Region subtag distinguishes from en-US.
Simplified Chinese. Script subtag 'Hans' per BCP 47. Recommended by Jellyfin over zh-CN.
Traditional Chinese. Script subtag 'Hant' per BCP 47.
Brazilian Portuguese. Very common in subtitle communities.
Latin American Spanish. 419 is UN M.49 region code for Latin America.
Vietnamese 2-letter code. Primary native language for this extension's target users.
Vietnamese 3-letter code. Less common but valid per ISO 639-2.
Japanese 2-letter code.
Japanese 3-letter code.
Korean 2-letter code.
Korean 3-letter code.
French 2-letter code.
French 3-letter code (ISO 639-2/T terminologic).
German 2-letter code.
German 3-letter code.
Uppercase language code. Algorithm must match case-insensitively.
Mixed case language code. Case-insensitive matching required.
Full language name. Supported by Emby (e.g., Home Alone.spanish.srt). Must map 'English' -> 'en'.
Lowercase full language name. Must map 'english' -> 'en' case-insensitively.
No language code. Fallback subtitle — used when no language-specific match found. Per Emby/Plex convention, bare .srt is treated as default/unknown language.
Subtitle with resolution in filename. Base name includes _1080p — must match video whose base is 'Movie' after resolution strip. Subtitle base should also be stripped of resolution for matching.
Fallback subtitle with resolution in name. Resolution must be stripped from subtitle base name too for matching.
Forced subtitle with no language code. 'forced' tag indicates foreign-language dialogue only. Per Emby convention: .forced or .foreign suffix.
SDH (Subtitles for Deaf and Hard of Hearing) with no language code. Per Emby convention: .sdh suffix.
English forced subtitles. Language code before tag. Pattern: base.lang.forced.ext
English SDH subtitles. Pattern: base.lang.sdh.ext
Vietnamese forced subtitles.
Subtitle with year in base name. Matches video 'Movie.Title.2023.1080p.*' after resolution strip.
Vietnamese subtitle with year in base name.
Multiple English subtitles disambiguated by -2 suffix. Per FileBot convention: eng-1, eng-2 etc. Algorithm should treat -2 as non-language suffix and still match 'en'.
3-letter code with SDH tag in mixed case. Per FileBot {subt} output format: .eng-SDH.srt
German hearing-impaired subtitle. 'hi' = hearing impaired (alternative to 'sdh'). Per Sublarr convention.
Spanish 3-letter code. Successfully recognized by Jellyfin (unlike 'chi' for Chinese).
Chinese with CN region. Problematic in Jellyfin — resolves to generic 'Chinese' instead of 'Simplified'. zh-Hans is preferred. Algorithm should still match this.
Default flag before language code. Per Emby: .default marks subtitle as default. Non-standard ordering — algorithm must handle tag before or after language.
